title.zh: 规定在八打雁省Balayan市镇设立急诊医院，名称为Balayan急诊医院，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for the Establishment of an Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of Balayan, Province of Batangas, to be Known as Balayan Emergency Hospital, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Establishment of an Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of Balayan, Province of Batangas, to be Known as Balayan Emergency Hospital, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Bệnh viện Cấp cứu tại Thị trấn Balayan, Tỉnh Batangas với tên gọi Bệnh viện Cấp cứu Balayan, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงพยาบาลฉุกเฉินในเทศบาล Balayan จังหวัด Batangas ในชื่อโรงพยาบาลฉุกเฉิน Balayan และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Rumah Sakit Gawat Darurat di Kotamadya Balayan, Provinsi Batangas dengan nama Rumah Sakit Gawat Darurat Balayan, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Hospital Kecemasan di Perbandaran Balayan, Wilayah Batangas dengan nama Hospital Kecemasan Balayan, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1964/ra_4139_1964.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established under the direct supervision of the Director of Medical Services, an emergency hospital in the Municipality of Balayan, Province of Batangas, to be known as Balayan Emergency Hospital.

The sum of two hundred thousand pesos is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of said hospital during the fiscal year nineteen hundred sixty-five. Thereafter, such sums as may be needed for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 20, 1964.
